Your Rouse prio is Miryiam into Fauxborn for Mob fights for the Shield on Exalt from Fauxborn Soulforge, and 1 Weak and 1 Vuln from Miryiam Rouse. For Boss fights, its Fauxborn Exalt to scale Life Steal stacks. Sometimes it’s Miryiam Rouse to survive turn 1 first with the Weakness and Exalt Shield.

Tulu exists to Exalt for 25%(Lvl 6) Crit Rate with “Dearest Friend” giving another 25%, totaling to 50% CR during Fauxborn Burst Turn. You never really rouse him, or 3rd…. He exists to give more Dmg to Tents and 1 Free Tent Slap.

For Goliath, you dont use any of his cards except for “Strike” and “Defense” for Aliemus. You never Rouse him. He exists to give you a fuck ton of Temp STR and Temp Tent Dmg for Burst Turn with Exalt. You go Tulu Exalt -> Red Stance -> Goliath Exalt.

For Miryiam, she is your bread and butter in this team. Her Exalts scale Tent Dmg, and you can Exalt often with Rouse to gain Fauxborn Sig Shields. Her 3 cost in your battery card for everyone to get their Exalts. Her 2 cost can be ignored and sold. Her Sacrament can be held to heal based on missing HP, or consumed as Obssesion for Aliemus on Miryiam. Really situation and playstyle depend. Her Rouse is the cornerstone of Miryiam.

> Part 1 - 3 cost: Gives Strike and 2 cost 100 CR, which is useless.
> Part 2 - 6 cost: Gives an option between Tent and STR, or Shield, on turn start. This is good and both are situational.
> Part 3 - 9 cost:At the end of this turn and end turns going forward, place one “Divine Realm’s Illusion” into your hand. Divine Realm’s Illusion takes 3 forms, and all give 25 Aliemus, and have Exhaust + Retain.

> Form 1: 1 Weak and 1 Vuln
> Form 2: Draw 2
> Form 3: 2 Arithma

Fauxborn is, and you are right about Sacrifice stacking. You Rouse as early as possible for Dmg, but Miryiam Rouse gives survivability first. Rousing gets those “Life Steal” stacks going for a stronger Exalt, very important. 3 cost is to scale Tent Dmg and gain Tents. However, if Burst Turn is occuring in the next 1-2 turns, then holding them in hand if possible is best + they have Retain. Her 0 cost is your bread and butter with 2 Arithma and 2 Draw and gaining 5% Max Hp Sacrifice, or discarding for 5% Max Hp Sacrifice **removal** at Lvl 6. You will need to balance and maintain your high Sacrifice with Fauxborn Soulforge and discarding 0 cost to maintain low Sacrifice on Mob fights. With E3, it helps greatly to be able to cycle 0 cost in hand with Strike or Defense, making you able to play 1 0 cost and discard 1 0 cost for Sac removal. You do want Sacrifice for Burst Turn since E2 Scales off that, but you dont wanna die. Later on, once you are more familiar, you can min max Sacrifice stacks before Fauxborn Exalt for CD, but for now, dont do that. So its very important you know your numbers and limits on that team. If you can kill the enemy before dying from Sacrifice, its all good. Finally her Exalt is after Goliath Exalt. 

I would say if you need Shield from Fauxborn Soulforge, order of prio for Exalts are Miryiam -> Tulu or Fauxborn -> Goliath. 

White Stance is another survival tool used in rotation with Fauxborn SF Shields.
Oh, and Fauxborn is your DPS, not Goliath, if that isnt clear yet…
Fauxborn Rouse: Gain 1 Life Steal every beginning of turn, max 5. Each granting 20% Dmg to Fauxborn Exalt. At 5 stacks, Fauxborn Exalt hits twice as many times as well.
